scope: Theorem 2.1 (Order-reversing image bound) of the manuscript “An exponential state lower bound for two-way nondeterministic complementation” (preprints/An-exponential-state-lower-bound-for-two-way-nondeterministic-complementation-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 129 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 302292b182622e12), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let m ≥ 1, let H be a finite set of cardinality h ≥ 2, and let S0 be a submonoid of Tm. Suppose that a surjective multiplicative map ϕ0 : S0 → RH satisfies z ⊑ w =⇒ ϕ0(w) ⊆ ϕ0(z) (z, w ∈ S0). (2.3) Then 2m ≥ 2⌊(h−2)/127⌋ . (2.4) The map need not initially be assumed to preserve identities.
